title: A passed trial waiting only for the Lead's manual sign-off wakes the Lead
description: Takes a submitted item through a real merge trial with one Lead-attestable manual proof left open and asserts the loop records a wake to the Lead's session naming the item, proof and head, lists it first in master status attention, and reports the acceptance wait split under waiting for sign-off in /api/flow.

steps.name: passed trial with one manual proof open wakes the Lead and splits acceptance wait in flow
